recent_en: JHM recently completed the cash acquisition of a property for RM20,900,000 and announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue and net profit rising both QoQ and YoY. In the news, attention is on the turnaround of its loss-making unit and recovery in automotive and semiconductor businesses.
notable_en: Acquired a property for RM20,900,000 cash under a signed sale and purchase agreement.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with both revenue and net profit increasing.
News headlines cited a turnaround of the loss-making unit and growth in automotive and semiconductor businesses driving an FY26 recovery.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM117,525,000 and net profit RM6,169,000, with a net margin of 5.2%; revenue rose 16.5% QoQ and 57.5% YoY, net profit increased 99.6% QoQ, and net margin improved from 3.1% to 5.2%.
